entries.progress_note: PDF text/OCR parsing now supports bounded 1/2/4-worker page chunks with deterministic page-order merge; full format and 10GB coverage remain planned.

Native PDF pages now retain a deterministic page type, specification section/Part/clause locators, and bordered table rows with bboxes. Text-layer slicing, word coordinates, local OCR fallback and bounded timeout checkpoints remain. Borderless/cross-page tables, multi-column reading order and complete semantic coverage remain planned; see docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md.

Local OCR, EXIF normalization, PDF CropBox coordinate transforms, selective overview routing, one bounded high-resolution schedule-table crop, evidence schema and matching previews are implemented. General drawing-region crops and live crop-quality validation remain planned.

RFC-style EML and bounded local Outlook MSG share one safe evidence path. Each MIME alternative group selects one non-empty body, preferring plain text then safe HTML; conflicting same-type choices warn instead of merging. A multipart/related start selects its matching Content-ID, with the first child as the standards fallback; non-root resources stay inert. EML and MSG parser inventory plus selected import use one MIME-derived name for unnamed parts so supported resources stay analyzable. Only a Subject with a normalized digit-bearing workflow ID can outrank an exact body heading. Every distinct exact marker is retained; a body-routed primary stops at any different exact RFI/Submittal section, while established valid-Subject priority remains. Thread headers accept bounded angle-bracketed local@domain tokens only. Exact history/signature boundaries and every nested message MIME part stay outside extraction. python-oxmsg handles MSG; mailbox sync, attachment recursion and semantic thread inference remain planned.

Exact RFI/Submittal aliases and workflow labels normalize across the one selected Email body, valid digit-bearing Subject and filename into a bounded read-only index. Distinct same-line and cross-type references are retained without donating role/status across body-routed sections; canonical duplicates collapse and valid Subject priority remains. A workflow-like Subject without an accepted ID remains evidence but cannot suppress an exact body primary. Malformed thread tokens, nested message bodies and non-root related resources cannot manufacture mixed roles. Known statuses remain metadata and conflicts stay ambiguous without precedence. Hash-only threads, selected attachments, SQLite projection and reviewer pagination remain deterministic and model-free.

Customer-configured Autodesk APS and Procore bearer connections browse and selectively import remote documents without remote writes. Imports reuse project limits, chunks, hashes and deduplication; live tenant validation and interactive OAuth remain planned.

A reviewer can inspect bounded attachment metadata and explicitly import one selected EML or MSG attachment through project capacity, chunk, SHA-256 and deduplication controls. Nested messages and related non-root resources remain inert; parser inventory and selected import share one standard MIME-derived name for unnamed parts so supported imports remain analyzable. Supplied names and conservative parser validation remain unchanged; no analysis or model call starts automatically.

Explicit RFI question/response roles, Submittal status and EML header/body roles are preserved deterministically before extraction. Full semantic classification, discipline/CSI assignment and user correction remain planned.

Mixed valid and ineligible workflow citations are filtered per evidence ID: RFI questions, rejected Submittals, email headers and quoted history cannot remain as direct material or QA support. Full revision-scope comparison remains planned.

Candidate conditions now inspect every remaining direct source, so a later RFI response, Submittal or current email body cannot be hidden by an earlier specification citation. A single Submittal source with multiple distinct explicit statuses is marked ambiguous instead of selecting one. Full cross-document latest-value selection remains planned.
A deterministic pre-publication check rejects descriptor/generic material names and removes duplicate or evidence-misaligned properties. Full option/entity mapping remains planned.

Mixed-source requirement and property citations are pruned per evidence ID while a field with valid direct support is preserved. Complete field-level evidence coverage across every output remains planned.
CAD对象/图层几何和PDF矢量审计已输出可追踪候选；尚未自动确认图例、重复表达及材料范围，因此不将候选直接写成设计净量。
所有CAD量算候选以PENDING导出；专用量算接受/驳回事件仍未实现。
PDF缺唯一比例或未映射材料时material_quantity保持null；DXF缺单位时不发布长度/面积候选。完整视图范围判定仍待实现。

A deterministic QA check requires an executable inspection/test action, excludes non-QA documents and generic objects, and keeps full extraction evidence for review. Full QA type coverage remains planned.

D-26 removes Missing Information from the current reviewer UI and exports; coverage remains visible on the run.
已有文件、片段、警告及PDF超时剩余页覆盖；全专业完整覆盖仍未实现。

The local dashboard now shows a stage-weighted analysis percentage, an elapsed-time estimated finish, coverage, cost, and aggregate timing. Polling is serialized and active runs avoid full result loading; the complete production dashboard remains planned.
D-27 implements user-selectable 1/2/4 local document parsing workers. Paid API requests remain serial; broader queued task orchestration is still planned.
DeepSeek关闭thinking与Gemini 3.6 Flash minimal已接线；复杂条件升级仍未实现。
D-27 adds aggregate stage, provider-wait, and model-response metrics plus processed-page counts. Per-call export and retry summaries remain planned.

Adjacent eligible extraction batches are capped at four fragments/8.8 KB with a stable recovery family. Ordinary evidence and matching exact workflow scopes still batch, while different RFI identifiers or roles, Submittal identifiers or statuses, and RFI/Submittal families close the batch before one prompt. Email headers, recognized history and signatures close locally, and a single PDF uses bounded page chunks. Paid calls remain serial and broader distributed orchestration remains planned.
原Run可在人工对账后恢复，跳过已完成文档和非PENDING片段；完整生产重试队列仍未实现。
本机原型已记录安全供应商诊断、成本状态和人工对账事件；完整可观测性仍未实现。

Native PDF evidence now carries detected Section, Part, clause, and bordered table-row context. Deterministic property checks reject context citations from a different document or non-local evidence range. Full inherited definitions, exceptions, footnotes and cross-page tables remain planned.
联合首读和UTF-8有界片段已实现；全项目上下文与完整关系抽取仍未完成。

Selective routing still limits vision to large-format, low-text graphic, or dense-graphic pages. Detected specification/schedule tables now use one bounded high-resolution crop with full-page coordinates, stable region identity, cache separation and crop preview; other eligible pages retain one overview call. General drawing-region detection and live crop-quality validation remain planned.
